text.en:
Precision Hits grant one charge of Snareweaver. Kills grant charges based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />. Maximum of 6 charges. Charges can be earned simultaneously. 

Charge progress from kills: 
• Minors: 1
• Elites, Minibosses, and Bosses: 2
• Players: 3

At full charge, hip-fired shots spawn a 'Snareweaver Trap' on impact. Direct Hits <strand/>Suspend the target and deploy the trap under them.

Snareweaver Traps form into 6 linked wires that last for 15 seconds. Enemies that come into contact with any wire are <strand/>Suspended, and each wire can Suspend up to 2 targets. A maximum of 6 enemies can be Suspended at once within a trap.

5 Second cooldown between <strand/>Suspends on the same enemy.

<strand/>Suspension lasts 6 seconds (8 with <strand/>Thread of Continuity). Suspend duration is halved against <link Minibosses [#CombatantClassifications] />.
